{"tool":"python","code":"from openpyxl.styles import PatternFill, Font

ws = wb.active

# Formula: search H:J for Name based on Title (B) and DeptCode (C)
# Using INDEX trick to force array evaluation without CSE
formula = '=IFERROR(INDEX($H$2:$H$35,MATCH(1,INDEX(($I$2:$I$35=B2)*($J$2:$J$35=C2),0),0)),"")'

fill = PatternFill(start_color='FCD5B4', end_color='FCD5B4', fill_type='solid')
font = Font(name='Arial', size=10)

for r in range(2, 36):
    cell = ws.cell(row=r, column=1)
    if r == 2:
        cell.value = formula
    else:
        # relative formula for each row
        cell.value = formula.replace('B2', f'B{r}').replace('C2', f'C{r}')
    cell.fill = fill
    cell.font = font

print('A2:', ws['A2'].value)
print('A3:', ws['A3'].value)
print('A35:', ws['A35'].value)
print('A2 fill:', ws['A2'].fill.fgColor.rgb)
print('A2 font:', ws['A2'].font.name)"}
